sentences.en: This is the ideology to which my speech is written.
sentences.zh: 这是我演讲所依据的思想体系。

sentences.en: Once more, fundamentalist ideologies are opposed to great historical advances.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，激进主义的思想意识与历史上的重大进步是相对立的。

sentences.en: Algerians should put ideology aside and build a stronger country.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚人应该抛开意识形态，努力建设一个更强大的国家。

senses.zh: 意识形态，思想体系；<古>观念学；<古>空想

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ideo（思想）+logy（…学）→思想体系，意识形态
